notes.title: Demo Update! - v0.9.6
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, esteemed collaborators![/p][p][/p][p]I hope you missed us a lot, because I for sure missed coming here to tell you that[b] we have a new demo update[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]We’ve worked a lot on this one, I mean, work is all we actually can do here. And now the build we made to surprise living souls at Gamescom Latam 2025 (and in our “Free Labor Day” Discord event) is finally within reach to all of you![/p][p][/p][p]Actually, we went a little overboard with the fixes and suggestions noted during the event and have already implemented a lot of them! So if you were amongst the thousands of eager living souls that [strike]worked for us[/strike] played the game during the event, there's new stuff here for you as well![/p][p][/p][h1]Demo Update[/h1][p]Yeah yeah, there is a really big changelog with all of the updates and additions listed at the end, but a couple of highlights will help you see the juicy parts first. But if you hate spoilers and love reading, feel free to just skip ahead in the post to find this update’s changelog. Otherwise, here are some key changes to this version:[/p][p][/p][h2]Updated Features[/h2][h3]Stage Selection Screen[/h3][p]Yeap, with this snazzy new screen, after you’ve selected who you’re working as in the Outfit Selection Screen, you will also choose the stage/location you will work at that time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/62ba3f75d62e6d0801ace9a7c19d551166398b50.png"][/img][/p][h3]Two new stages[/h3][p]You’ve read this right [strike]or maybe not, I don’t know what you can actually read[/strike], TWO new stages, in a way.[/p][p]Now you’re not confined to the company’s private graveyard and recruitment site, now you can [strike]invade[/strike] expand your work activities into two new places: a really calm village and a really busy mine! With this update, you’ll be able to explore the calm village in a forest with a lot of boars, and after beating the local Hero there, you’ll unlock the cool experience of delving into the depths of the kingdom’s most important mine, full of new enemies and profitable souls! [/p][p]Don’t reading about it gets your capitalist soul shivering with anticipation?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/e7f62d1b55a35d80617b524122fc7f69f5eab2e2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/d7d3624e5b16852e62d58d6328bb7d4f22bfb5ad.png"][/img][/p][h3]Save Safeguard[/h3][p]One of the problems some of you living souls were facing was “how do I reset my save file or guarantee it is updated?” well, Upper Management has heard your feedback and acted upon it (ironic, considering they always ignore mine)!  Now whenever you open the Demo, it will check to see if your save file is up-to-date considering the version you are playing at the moment, and if you are outdated it will prompt you with a choice to delete your save file to prevent any issues. [/p][p]Yeah, for now our only solution to protect your save is to kill it, who would’ve thought? You also have the option to manually decide to delete your save and start anew in the main menu, if you decide to do so for whatever strange reason you living souls have.[/p][p]Oh, and don't worry! Despite highly recommended, resetting your save is optional. In fact, if you do choose to reset it, you can even choose to keep half of your previous Eternal Scrips total.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/8ac28f538fadf03fb13ed5be0900e1c9936a5d84.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There are actually a couple of other things we’re working on at the moment that will enhance the experience even further, but Management has told us to hold on to those for a little while because, and I quote “Don’t spoil them too much otherwise they will start demanding actual payment”. But Bard said he is almost convincing them to let us give you those new things as well, but who knows if he’s saying the truth or just boasting?[/p][p][/p][p]And as always: yes, the update is live right now! So get to work! And don’t worry, if you have any problems, doubts, suggestions or just want to chat with us, we are always available on our Discord server, which you can join through the demo’s main menu. Our marketing team reinforced that it was good for the company if our Discord was more “alive”, and I find this offensive. But please feel free to give us a hello over there![/p][p][/p][p]And that’s it for this news-update. Thank you so much for your overwhelming support and understanding! The reception during the live events with this build was incredible, so we think you’ll love it as well.[/p][p][/p][p][b]E-Lich Corp[/b] - "We value your life. And death. Seriously."[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/8ac28f538fadf03fb13ed5be0900e1c9936a5d84.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Changelog v0.9.6[/h1][h2]New Content[/h2][list][*][p]1 new Spell Evolution[/p][/*][*][p]5 new Boons[/p][/*][*][p]1 new Artifact[/p][/*][*][p]1 new Talent[/p][/*][*][p]2 new Stages[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Enemies[/h3][list][*][p][b]Crystal Golems[/b] - "They were once men..." ..or something like that. Don't let their beautiful and valuable magical crystal shell fool you, what's truly valuable is what's inside! Yes, I mean their souls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exploding Spiders[/b] - "Now twice as dreadful!" ... Seriously, don't let these things get near you. If even the living are blast into pieces, just imagine how far they can scatter our bones when they go boom.[/p][/*][*][p]And more dangers for you to find![/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Evolutions![/b][/p][list][*][p]Some spells and weapons can now be evolved into stronger versions of themselves after reaching max level and having certain boons[/p][/*][*][p]A proper in-game guide on evolutions will be added at a later date[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Spell Reworks![/b][/p][list][*][p]Our spells and weapons are currently being reworked to improve lots of stuff and add new technical possibilities (new behaviours, performance, etc)[/p][/*][*][p]Orbit Spell can now scale with both projectile size and area size, increase the radius at which it spins around you[/p][/*][*][p]Magic Missile's target tracking was improved[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Added a Stage Select screen![/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 2 new Stages![/p][/*][*][p]Stages now have proper lighting, animated objects and VFXs[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Added Chest Indicators![/b][/p][list][*][p] Dropped chests' position will now be indicated in the UI if they are outside of your screen[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Added Tooltips![/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now check more info about Stats and Status Effects during Boon Selection / Level Up[/p][/*][*][p]The stats displayed across boons and artifacts have been standardised to the same color to avoid that confusing green / red text that didn't mean an upgrade nor downgrade to a stat[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added new animated character portrait expressions![/p][/*][*][p]Added new dialogues[/p][/*][*][p]Added an "Outfit Unlocked" popup for when you unlock new Character Outfits[/p][/*][*][p]Added names and health bars to Adventurers and some special enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked most boons and artifacts' descriptions for improved clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked some UI Elements to improve visual clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked some Talents' icons[/p][/*][*][p]Faye's Talent Screen has received yet more visual updates[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the generic UI button for improved visibility[/p][/*][*][p]Level Up Screen's header is now dynamic and reacts to what's happening during the level up process[/p][/*][*][p]Added a language toggle in the main menu's top right corner to more quickly swap the language if necessary[/p][/*][*][p]Added SFXs to some UI elements that were silent[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balancing[/h2][list][*][p]The pickup range talent now has 5 levels instead of 3.[/p][/*][*][p]A Specific Magical Railgun - Only half of additional Attack Speed is now applied to Damage Multiplier instead of a 1:1[/p][/*][*][p]Reality-bending Lens: Projectile Size bonus reduced from 100% to 50%. However, now half of your additional Projectile Size is also applied to your Damage Multiplier[/p][/*][*][p]Retro 3D Glasses: Projectile Size bonus reduced from 50% to 40%[/p][/*][*][p]Orb of Limitless Ponderation: Exp Multiplier reduced from 60% to 55%[/p][/*][*][p]Alcabone's Guidance now also increases Pickup Range by 30%[/p][/*][*][p]Projectile Case changed from Common to Uncommon[/p][/*][*][p]Profane Aura's base area size increased from 1.2 to 1.3[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Improved many systems' performance and stability[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a severe logic issue with some stats multiplication leading to wrong math[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several bugs with the boss[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Boss's SFXs being super loud[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the boss entering a loop of using the same ability over and over again if you leveled up while he was casting one of his abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stats not updating immediately in the lobby after you upgrade / downgrade talents[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Stat Conversion artifacts not immediately applying the conversion after being picked up[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some other localization issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some typos[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some Lobby elements not being affected by lights[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed boons on the Current Boons Screen displaying stat key names instead of translated text[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the HP logic that could lead to the HP bar not representing the player's current HP correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with UI navigation that sometimes prompted errors when closing menus[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked some logic involving enemy projectiles and fixed the player not taking damage from them under some circumstances[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked and improved the Level Up logic and flow.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked and improved the Revive logic. Also fixed the VFX sometimes happening twice[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked and improved the Boon pool system[/p][list][*][p]  This has improved which boons can appear and when, as well as fixed a couple of issues when trying to draw certain boons[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed some SFXs playing on wrong parts of the UI[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some SFXs not playing on some parts of the UI[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the weapon list's scroll in the results screen not working with the mouse[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the buttons in the results screen losing their reference while playing with a controller and forcing you to click on them with the mouse[/p][/*][*][p]And so, so, so much more... (I miss vacations...)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Gamescom Latam 2025 + Upcoming Exclusive Event!
notes.content:
Greetings, esteemed collaborators!

Sometimes we have to halt the reaping of souls a little to work on some PR with all of you living souls. And that usually means attending "live" events. So, let's talk [b]Gamescom Latam 2025[/b] and a couple of other public appearances.

Yes, we'll be participating in Gamescom Latam for the second year in a row. But if that wasn't cool enough, this time our participation comes with a plus: 
[h2]We are among the nominees for the "Best Brazilian Game" award![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/313ff4da0d0f7015ecaf55f4deb0fd2ed99647d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/320aafa6c1f6b6172ce56700a9a40fc66be1dadc.png[/img]

So yet again, we have been selected along with a couple of awesome games as nominees for this incredible prize. Because of that, we will once again have a new and updated version playable on-site during the event, with members of our Upper Management present to bribe you with goodies! Some cool graphic design material will be available for corporate bribes, I mean, promotion. So please make sure to meet us and get yours (if event management asks, it is totally not a bribe to vote for us. [i]Sorry, can't wink as a skeleton[/i]).

[h2]Achievement Unlocked: Two years in a row competing for votes[/h2]
As part of our presence at Gamescom LATAM, being nominees and all, not only are we being evaluated by a judging committee, but also by all you living souls attending there! There's a thing called [b]"Public Vote for best game"[/b] and I'm told we may have a chance if we promise to reap you last. [u]Please don't forget to vote for us if you like our experience.[/u] I'm told that our voting performance will be used to evaluate my promotion request, and I really want to be a Senior Intern.

[h3]What else can you expect at the event?[/h3]
Besides basic bribery and flattery for votes, in our new and improved Demo, you will find:
- New Boons
- New Stages
- New enemies to reap
- New undying loyalty to your company

And to prove we are not lying to you like certain companies do, we actually attended a couple live events in the past few months and showed them the new experiences. Why we didn't warn you in advance? Well... funny you should ask. Inhuman Resources asked me the same thing, and all I can think about is the fact I was kinda overworked and forgot to post about them, sorry. They demanded me to compensate you all with extra puns whenever requested at Gamescom. 

[h3]Now look at some cool pics of our presence at those events:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/2b037ad4a8ad0ac54d3faaf2c133e5f444036657.jpg[/img]
Yes, I'm aware we're in dire need of an actual photographer. But if they can't pay me, do you think they can pay a professional?!

[h2]BUT WAIT, THERE'S MORE![/h2]
We have an exclusive online event just for you (yes you)! 
[b]Would you like to play an [u]exclusive[/u] preview of the Gamescom Build in all its glory?[/b]

I know you do, so here's how you can do it:

[b]We will be hosting our second "Live-support" event[/b], also known as "unpaid labor day", [b]on the last Friday of April.[/b] 

This means that [u]on the 25th of April we will have Gamescom Latam's build exclusively available for our Discord server members.[/u] And you can be one of the lucky few as well, just join us there and chat with us a little (we don't reap). That means that even if you can't be present at Gamescom, you can play it (even earlier than most living souls).

On that day, not only will the build be available, we will also be present there all day long to give you technical and moral support. As well as create event-specific quests that, if completed, will reward you with everlasting glory, and us with everlasting feedback and bug-hunting. So don't miss that opportunity, join us and get yourself an exclusive preview! 

For more info on the event, check our "announcements" channel on Discord for all relevant details.

Last but not least, as you probably have noticed from this announcement and our store page, we have a brand-new look! This is our first step towards the "final phase" before release. We'll have more on that in the next couple of weeks/months/years (or as soon as I can catch a break, really), so stay tuned for upcoming announcements!

That’s it for this update. Be sure to check out our social media for the latest news and sneak peeks on the game and (probably) on-site updates about our team's presence at Gamescom Latam 2025. Thanks for reading and keep on living (until we come to collect)!

[b]E-Lich Corp[/b] - "We value your life. And death. Seriously."

notes.title: Update 0.9.5b - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings, esteemed collaborators!

According to our living-world calendars, it must be the beginning of 2025 for you, give or take 10 years. 

So to kick things off, here's our first update of 2025 (or whatever silly year it is over there now), which has been in the works since the beginning of last month. And let me tell you, it's packed to the bone!

But before that, Inhuman Resources demanded I gave a spotlight on some of the things that are included in this update!

[h2]New Boss HP Bar[/h2]
Boss enemies now have their HP displayed at all times to make sure you notice when the boss spawns (and dies!). It should also help you realize when you accidentally kill them off-screen now (since you've been doing that so often, you hard-working soul).

[h2]Revamped Talents Screen[/h2]
Ms.Faye is working on some new stuff! She mentioned something about new talents and some features being held back by Inhuman Resources for further analysis, so they might still take a while to be available for general use (but you can catch a glimpse of them in there now).

[h2]Revamped Dialogue Box UI[/h2]
The Dialogue Box UI has received yet another round of upgrades, looking more sleek, responsive (especially for keyboard and controller navigation, whatever that means), and beautiful. It should also improve the visualization of what option you are currently selecting.

[h2]Overall New Content![/h2]
Of course, there are new boons, artifacts, talents, and even new enemies! Get out there and try them out for yourself (it is not an option, the boss kinda demands it)!

And that's about it!
Please look forward to upcoming updates, we are being worked to death to get them to you.

[b]E-Lich Corp[/b] - "We value your life. And death. Seriously."

[h1]Changelog v0.9.5b[/h1]
[h2]New Content[/h2]
[h3]New Boons & Artifacts[/h3]
- Box of Unread CVs - Increases Exp Gain by 3% and Critical Chance by 1%
- Nepotist's Special Blend - Increases Move Speed by 5%, Attack Speed by 20% and Dash Charges by 1, but reduces Health by 10%
- Mobile Game Ad - Increases Projectile Duration by 5%, but reduces HP Regen by 1%
- Edgy Cosplay - Increases Base Damage by 2, Damage Multiplier by 20% and Attack Speed by 20%, but reduces Exp Gain by 20%
- Pocket Particle Accelerator - Increases Projectile Speed by 120%, but reduces Projectile Duration by 20%
- Indestructible Pager - Increases Base Damage and Armor by 0.6
- Shiba Plushie - Increases HP Regen by 12%
- Sunstone - Increases Base Damage and HP by 40%
- And more!

[h3]New Enemies[/h3]
- Golden Boar - Rare special enemy that gives a lot of exp and guarantees a chest drop

[h2]Changes[/h2]
- Added more spawn points for adventurers and bosses! They'll no longer only spawn on the top right corner of the screen
- Revamped the dialogue options' UI to make it clearer which option you currently have selected
- Revamped the icons of some older boons
- Revamped the art of swordsman adventurers (with others to follow soon)
- Slightly increased Fireball's minimum size cap to avoid it getting too tiny
- Reintroduced the Domain Expansion boon to the pool
- Several UI improvements across all screens / menus
- Heavily improved UI controller navigation
- Improvements to the Dialogue Box UI

[h2]Rebalances[/h2]
- Increased the Boss's HP and Armor scaling
- Exp Gain Boon - Now has 3 levels instead of 4
- Improved the chance of Poison Aura appearing during boon selection
- Automatic Vaccum Cleaner - Now reaches 100% in 2 levels instead of 3
- Slightly reduced enemy scaling past 15 minutes / after the Boss is defeated

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed an issue with the stat upgrade formula that led to certain boons increasing some stats by way more than they should
- Fixed an issue where you couldn't confirm your selection with the controller on the Character Select screen
- Fixed the Transmute Talent increasing a Reroll charge instead of a Transmute one, which led to 6 Reroll charges and 4 Transmute charges instead of 5 and 5 when both talents were maxed
- Fixed the red part of the Boss's HP Bar not being displayed
- Fixed an issue where the dialogue options didn't display correctly when more than 1 option was available
- Fixed boon descriptions in the tooltips at Current Boons and Results Screen displaying localization keys instead of the actual localized stat
- Fixed boon tooltips displaying wrong fonts
- Fixed some minor font issues
- Fixed some buttons not having any sort of indication they were being highlighted or selected
- Fixed exp bar's "Level" text not reflecting the chosen localisation option until you picked up a soul
- Fixed the next dialogue indicator not changing to controller buttons when the Intern was talking

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
- Performance still drops when running late game builds with lots of projectiles.
- Some weapons still have weird behaviours, namely Hate 2.O, but may apply to others
- Can't see collected Artifacts on the Boons Screen
- Can't use the mouse to scroll on the combat statistics list on the result screen (using W/S keys or a controller both work at the moment)
- Controller / Keyboard navigation in the new Delete Save option can lose reference of the selected button, making it impossible to interact with it. A mouse is likely required for interacting with it at the moment (we're working on a fix!)

notes.title: Update 0.9.5a - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings, esteemed collaborators!

We've managed to squeeze another "tiny" update right before you mortals celebrate the holidays!

Enjoy the festivities and be sure to let us know if you find any further bugs with the Mortician Update. Management said our developers would be delighted to fix them asap since we have no holidays over here.

[b]E-Lich Corp[/b] - "We value your life. And death. Seriously."

[h1]Changelog v0.9.5a[/h1]
[h2]New Content[/h2]
[h3]New Boons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Milk Infusion - Increases HP Regen by 0.3 and Armor by 15%
[/list]
[h3]New Talents[/h3]
6 new talents that affect the following stats:
[list]
[*] Projectile Duration
[*] Projectile Size
[*] Projectile Speed
[*] Area Size
[*] Knockback Strength
[*] Defense Pierce
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Stats displayed on Boons and Talents are now coloured according to their category (just like how they're displayed on Stats Screen)
[*] Boons' descriptions are now more standardised and less confusing in terms of which stats they affect
[*] Improved the collision on most objects in the Graveyard map and removed collision from some small plants
[*] Re-positioned some objects in the Graveyard map around to avoid situations where the player would get stuck
[*] Revamped Thunder Spell's VFX (still affects performance, so it's a WIP)
[*] Slight improvements to Blizzard's VFX. Also, its projectile's initial size is now twice as large
[*] Revamped the 1st Boss ranged attack's VFX
[*] Revamped enemy phrases during a run
[*] Adventurers can now speak too!
[*] Phrases also make more sense and are now more specific according to situation and the enemy speaking (no more villagers rushing towards you while asking you not to kill them)
[*] Improved legibility of Talents description
[/list]

[h2]Rebalances[/h2]
[list]
[*] The 1st Boss - now starts with 20 Armor instead of 5 and should no longer be easily knocked back
[*] Recluses Aura - Now also reduces the time to push enemies by 0.5s on levels 4 and 8
[*] Ethereal Blades - Increased base Projectile Pierce from 3 to 4
[*] Blizzard - Base Attack Speed slowed from 3.5 to 3.7
[*] Dysfunctional Projectiles - now increases Projectile Speed by 55% instead of 50% and decreases Projectile Duration by 45% instead of 50%
[*] Adamantium Infusion - now has 2 Levels instead of 1
[*] Critically Acclaimed Game Poster - now also increases Base Damage by 1.4
[*] Power Tattoo - Critical Chance now decreases by 40% instead of 20%
[*] Domain Expansion Permit - Area Size bonus decreased from 60% to 50%
[*] Extended Warranty - Projectile Duration bonus decreased from 25% to 15%
[*] Forced Transfusion - Life Steal Chance decreased from 5% to 1%
[*] Longevity Potion - HP% Bonus decreased from 200% to 100%
[*] Military Grade Extended Barrel - Projectile Speed bonus decreased from 25% to 20%
[*] Orb of Limitless Ponderation - Exp Gain decreased from 70% to 60%, now also decreases Move Speed by 5%
[*] Pocket Particle Accelerator - now also decreases Projectile Duration by 20%
[*] Projectile Case - Projectile Duration bonus decreased from 10% to 5%
[*] Scroll of Extended Lifespan - Projectile Duration bonus decreased from 60% to 40%
[*] Cursed Status Effect - Curse now decreases enemy armor by 25% instead of 10%
[*] Crit Chance Talent - Increases Critical Chance by 3% instead of 2%
[*] Total Damage Mult Talent - Increased base cost from 100 to 200 and consecutive levels now cost 200 more per level
[*] HP Regen Talent - Base cost reduced from 400 to 200 and consecutive levels are cheaper
[*] Attack Speed Talent - Cost has been reduced from the 2nd level onwards
[*] Additional Projectiles Talent - Max Level increased from 2 to 5. First 2 levels are now cheaper
[*] Dash Charges Talent - Cost reduced for levels 4 and 5
[*] Dash Invulnerability - Cost reduced from 500 to 400
[*] Fear of Compromise Talent - Cost increased from 2nd level onwards
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a softlock that ocurred if you interacted with two chests at the exact same time
[*] Fixed a softlock caused by picking up the Power Tattoo boon
[*] Fixed Power Tattoo increasing way more than 200% Crit Damage and decreasing more than 20% Crit Chance
[*] Fixed a bug with the dialogue UI that could sometimes make you unable to pass the current dialogue by pressing the interaction key
[*] Fixed a bug with the dialogue UI that allowed the interaction key to open the log panel and skip the dialogue
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented keyboard and controller navigation on the Retry and Back To Lobby buttons on the results screen
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented keyboard and controller navigation from boons to reroll/transmute/banish if you didn't have at least one reroll charge
[*] Fixed several missing SFXs
[*] Fixed enemy phrases still being displayed during the death screen and results screen
[*] Fixed some typos and small text issues in some dialogues
[*] Fixed the Base HP Talent saying it increased your HP by 10 instead of 20
[*] Fixed Life Steal Talent's cost being 666 for every level
[*] Fixed some inconsistencies in some boons' stat values between localization versions
[*] Fixed some SFXs being louder than they should be
[*] Fixed some UI elements displayed on the Lobby being slightly out of place
[*] Fixed some VFXs still being displayed during the death screen and results screen
[*] Fixed Magic Missile's VFX displaying a weird "particle shower effect" upon exploding
[*] Fixed Hate.2.O's VFX (it's now an improved version of what was on Gamescom's build)
[*] Fixed Hate.2.O not levelling up to level 8 like other spells (hopefully this will get it out of the bottom tier of some player's tier lists...)
[*] Hopefully fixed a bug where the Boars would start to speak latin (?)
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] FPS drops considerably when having too many projectiles (VFXs) on screen, especially Thunder. Performance may change according to hardware
[*] Hate.2.O doesn't throw bottles towards the player's south
[*] Hate.2.O's puddle doesn't increase with Area Size, only the throw distance is affected
[*] Boons on the Boons Screen display stat key names instead of translated text
[*] Can't see collected Artifacts on the Boons Screen
[*] Can't confirm your selection with the controller on the Character Select screen
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update - The Mortician Update!
notes.content:
Greetings esteemed collaborators!

It’s been a hot minute, but we’re delighted to finally be able to announce that [b]we have a new demo update![/b]

Management wanted me to make a whole mystery about it, but who has time for that? Not me, I’m overworked.

So let’s talk about the “Mortician Demo Update”!

[h1]Mortician Demo Update[/h1]
If you’re up to date with our latest announcements, these will be of no surprise for you, so feel free to just skip ahead in the post to find this update’s [url=#Changelog]Changelog[/url]. But if you’re not aware of our previous sneak-peaks, here are some key changes to this version:

[h2]Updated Features[/h2]
[h3]Character Selection[/h3]
Previously you had to actually TALK to your coworkers to change into their clothes and work as them. But aside from the fact you’d be changing clothes in the middle of the office, honestly: who actually wants to talk with their colleagues every single time? Not this skeleton. Now we have an actual locker room dedicated to giving you the privacy you need while selecting whichever collaborator you want to pretend to be that time and directly go to work on the field. And you can even compare stats to boost, no more blind picks!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/0ee325ca5722048bda74d6444b280aeaafcaed25.gif[/img]

[h3]Boon Selection[/h3]
One of the best perks of working here is the wide array of boons to our collaborators on the field, we know this and so do you. But we noticed that some living souls didn’t 100% understand all the differences in importance and types (yeah, management hears your feedback, just not mine), so it was all revamped to help even the newest of interns to comprehend it all!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/bc9ac1e8ae9a4b41aa69817560c8de868b3db80e.gif[/img]

[h2]New Mechanics[/h2]
[h3]Status Effects[/h3] 
Even though Warrior loves focusing only on pure damage, we know that [strike]killing[/strike] collecting human souls sometimes asks for a more refined approach… like poison. So now some Boons will help you by adding a probability that your damage can also apply Poison, Burning or a Curse (which lowers the enemy’s defense temporarily) to all the living souls!

PS: Rogue told me that our R&D department has a lot more on this feature in the works, and that only an initial version of it was released, so you can expect a more in-depth status effects system soon (I guess)!

[h2]Updated Visuals[/h2]
[h3]Level Up[/h3] 
Leveling up has never been this satisfying! There’s a whole new VFX to properly indicate when you level up, as well as to make it clear how it is that the enemies were being pushed back whenever it happened.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/162a4659a3fd4c02661bda94483798b5deca17b3.gif[/img]

[h3]Unstable Phylactery / Revive[/h3]
Yes, this artifact is incredible. And yes, we know you couldn’t tell when it activated because there was no visual indicator. Now whenever you [strike]are killed[/strike] start an overtime shift you can clearly see it activating, getting you back to work and wiping the screen off of enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/9d1992a244c56ff7c70d5c830037ca0b7ece20d5.gif[/img]

[h2]New Boons[/h2]
You know what? I’m not gonna spoon-feed this part with my slick note-taking skills, you can check out the changelog at the end of this post if you want to read about all the new Boons!

And I assure you that they will greatly aid you during your runs. Especially that aura stuff…

Anyway...

As of this post, it is now [b]Friday the 13th[/b] of this month! We were told this date holds some significance for you living souls when talking about the undead and overall horrors, so we thought it a perfect date to release our new update!

Yes, the update is live right now! So get to work! And don’t worry, if you have any problems, doubts, suggestions or just want to chat with us, we will be online and ready to help you with some “live” customer-support on our Discord server, which you can join through the demo’s main menu now as well.

We’re already dead enough ourselves, so our marketing team said it was good for the company if our Discord was more “alive”, or whatever that means. So we’re [strike]being forced to[/strike] gladly working on it!

And that’s it for this news-update. Thank you so much for your overwhelming support and understanding! We will by happily waiting for all of you on our Demonstration Day (not like we have a choice). See you soon!

[b]E-Lich Corp[/b] - "We value your life. And death. Seriously."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/8ac28f538fadf03fb13ed5be0900e1c9936a5d84.gif[/img]

[h1=Changelog]Changelog[/h1]
[h2]New Content[/h2]
[h3]New Spells[/h3]
[list]
[*] Poison Aura
 • Creates an area around you that deals damage to enemies inside it. Can't Crit
[*] Recluse's Aura
 • Creates an area around you that pushes enemies away from you every 3s. Doesn't deal damage
[/list]
[h3]New Boons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dysfunctional Projectiles (Uncommon)
 • Increases Projectile Speed by 50%, but reduces Projectile Duration by 50%
[*] Knock-off Supplies (Uncommon)
 • Increases Damage Multiplier by 5% and Knockback Strength by 5%
[*] Mythril Mail (Legendary)
 • Increases Armor by 10 and Move Speed by 10%
[*]Vacation Voucher (Common)
 • Increases Health by 2% and Health Regen by 0.2
[*] And more!
[/list]
[h3]New Artifacts[/h3]
[list]
[*] A Specific Magical Railgun
 • Bonus Attack Speed is also applied to your Damage multiplier
[/list]
[h3]New Talents[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dash Invulnerability
 • Makes you invulnerable while dashing!
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a Character Selection Screen and improved the process of starting a new run
 • Due to this, you can no longer change to an NPC's outfit in the lobby by speaking with them, nor can you start a run by speaking with the NPC beside the elevator
[*] Reworked and improved the Boon Selection Screen
[*] Slightly reworked the Dialogue Box UI to improve readability and avoid confusion with the Skip button
[*] Made many small visual changes to the Lobby
[*] The Janitor is back at work! He's still not very friendly or talkative, but he can be found in the Lobby
[*] Added a VFX for when the player revives
[*] Reworked and improved the VFX that plays when you level up
[*] Many balancing changes to boons, spells, weapons and enemies
[*] The Reaper's Scythe artifact now has a cap for its damage increase
 • It now also increases your HP based on how many enemies you kill after you pick this artifact
[*] Added new icon art for boons and artifacts that still had either placeholder or duplicate art
[*] The Dash button should no longer be indicated alongside the movement and pause button indicators when you start a run if you don't have it unlocked yet (we're sorry for the confusion it caused!)
[*] Reworked the game's fonts
[*] Changed the size of many text boxes across all screens to improve readability and avoid huge differences between text sizes (especially when changing languages)
[*] Added a "Join our Discord!" button and a "Wishlist Now!" button to the Main Menu
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some instances where dialogue would skip multiple lines without pressing the Skip button
[*] Fixed the Lock Camera option in the settings menu
[*] Fixed the Intern not blinking during dialogue (probably happened due to coffee overload)
[*] Fixed some objects being out of position or overlapping others in the lobby
[*] Fixed the Area Size stat not being displayed in the Stats Screen
[*] Fixed Blizzard spell not levelling up to Level 8 like most spells
[*] Fixed Rogue's Dash Cooldown being much quicker than everyone else's
[*] Fixed the main weapons not updating their stats until being leveled up again
[*] Fixed some issues with the controller support
[*] Fixed many localization issues for the PT-BR language version
[*] Fixed several font-related issues for texts on the PT-BR language version
[*] Fixed some screens and texts not being translated
[*] Fixed several bugs on the Talent Screen
[*] Dozens of other bug fixes
[/list]
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Clicking on a dialogue to make the text be revealed all at once can sometimes advance to the next dialogue instead of waiting to display the current one's full text. We're working on a fix as we speak (type?)!
[*] The boss can sometimes move awkwardly after using his jump attack. Good for you, bad for balancing, I suppose... Working on a fix!
[*] Some UI elements have missing SFXs or are mistakenly using SFXs from other UI elements. Also working on it!
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update - October 2024
notes.content:
Greetings esteemed collaborators!

We've returned with a few updates since the release of our first demo, and this time we have some mixed news—some exciting and cool, and some... not as much (but trust me, it’ll all be worth it!).

Let’s talk Demo Updates and Early Access!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/8ac28f538fadf03fb13ed5be0900e1c9936a5d84.gif[/img]

So, to address the skeleton-elephant in the room:

Upper Management has hit a few bumps over the past couple of months, leading to unexpected delays and schedule changes. Due to that, [b]we'll be extending the time between Demo Updates and, unfortunately, pushing our Early Access release to early 2025[/b]. 

[b]But fear not[/b], dear mortals! We’re working our unpaid-best to get everything back on track as soon as possible!

We can't share all the details due to respecting personal privacy (after all, we’re not one of those ruthless corporations that sell your data), but rest assured, we’re all well. We just need a bit more time to sort things out. Thank you for your understanding!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/3b8219a6cea1ead84566685a1a758bdeac295d64.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/78703fd912d7fb2d153d50a767cb49bda241c55e.png[/img][/url]

But we’re not letting this message end in a low-note, so I asked Rogue to “borrow” some sneak-peeks of what you can expect in the next Demo Update. Remember to thank the “nice” skeleton after this:

Demo Build Name: “Mortician”
Update focus: Visual and handling experience (what the heavens does this mean??)

[h1]Revamped Screens & UI Improvements[/h1]
As spoiled in a previous post, some screens have been completely revamped with beautiful and informative additions, and they'll be in this demo very soon! No more having to directly talk to your coworkers to choose working for them, now you can simply [i]borrow[/i] their clothes from the locker room!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/0ee325ca5722048bda74d6444b280aeaafcaed25.gif[/img]

And if you remember the last preview of the upcoming revamped Boon Selection screen, here is a GIF of it working in-game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/bc9ac1e8ae9a4b41aa69817560c8de868b3db80e.gif[/img]
I did the math and it is at least 106.66% cooler!

[h2]Less Confusing Dialog Box UI[/h2]
Another thing we've noticed is that many mortals have been getting confused by the skip button and where to actually click to progress the dialog, which caused many of you to skip dialog unintentionally.

So to fix that, we're trying out some slight changes to the Dialog Box UI. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/62025dd9a185b46739e4a6544dfe1b372a3049b3.gif[/img]
Hopefully you'll find it clearer than before, but if you don't, do let us know so we can [strike]get shouted at for failing again[/strike] improve it even further!

[h1]New Content[/h1]
To be honest, I don’t know how much content they'll let me spoil and how much will be redacted.

[h2]More Boons![/h2]
I've been having a blast testing these out, and trust me, REDACTED and REDACTED are great additions! Just look at these cool boons:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/5e9eaf1578775c2c0f3dc729b89ff9285478d5bc.png[/img]
Oh, and did you know that the demo has many boons that aren't currently available in the pool of options? I've heard some of them have been either reworked or fixed and should be reintroduced (or should I say introduced since you didn't see them yet?) to the pool in the next update too!

[h2]New Enemies[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/82dd0ecfb14708f4916d06a0c8fbae3c391abdb5.gif[/img]
You know what they say: "A man's entertainment is another's extra shift" - or something like that...

Anyway, I was told you'd be happy to know that more Adventurers have been accepting quests nearby, so they might show up in the Graveyard soon. [i]Yay...[/i]

[h2]New Talents & Discounts![/h2]
There are new Talents available, so be sure to talk to Miss Faye on the next update and check them out!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/5f1a891d65db690135873f63df9e97dcea7c4240.png[/img]

Oh, and it seems we've finally managed to convince her to charge less for some Talents, especially considering some of them weren't even working correctly in the first place... Which she also assured me should be fixed in the next update as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/8ac28f538fadf03fb13ed5be0900e1c9936a5d84.gif[/img]

I’ll stop with the spoilers here because Rogue said he will start charging me at this point, and I’m already deep in debt. So if you want to know more, feel free to talk directly to Management in our [url=https://discord.gg/xHRDNdgxGJ ]Discord Server[/url]! 

You can use that space to hear all about the development, share your ideas and even compete with other mortals to see who gets the best results during their shifts (yay, free labor!).

And that’s it for this update. Thanks for your overwhelming support and understanding, we promise to work ourselves to the bone to give you the best experience! And keep an eye open for the next posts, it shouldn’t take long.

E-Lich Corp - "We value your life. And death. Seriously."

notes.title: Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello, esteemed collaborators! 

We have big news for y'all concerning something you were asking about all the time (like, daily).

We could tell you more about our struggles to fight off the accidentally summoned demon in our office for the past couple of weeks, but I personally think we should let past mistakes behind and not blame [REDACTED] or anyone else for it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/8ac28f538fadf03fb13ed5be0900e1c9936a5d84.gif[/img]

So anyway, let's talk about the [b]DEMO[/b]!

First things first (and I know that this is an obvious reminder, but still), please keep in mind [b]this demo is a work in progress[/b]!

That can mean:
- Bugs
- Unpolished features
- Lacking dialog (aside from Dolores and Ms.Faye, our field team wasn't really in the mood to talk much during development)
- Possible delays in updates due to new demon summonings in the office
- More bugs

With that said, as of this moment, this demo is the exact same one we playtested over on Gamescom Latam, so unless our competition pulled our rug without us knowing, it should be very stable!

[h3]Now, as for what you CAN expect from this demo:[/h3]
- Lots of boons and spells to choose from! (These are your upgrades during a run)
- 15 minutes of surprisingly tough villagers trying to kill you
- 15 minutes of reaping the souls of said villagers
- A few Adventurers that were hired to send you back to the grave with severe violence (that may or may not come mounted in Warthogs. Yeap, Warthogs)
- 1 Hero to defeat (that strangely enough shows up again even if you reap his soul)
- A preview of our grand idea of what would be to mix The Office and Vampire Survivors! (Our business team said I should mention this to improve likeability and downloads)

[b]But that's not all![/b]

We've been tirelessly (and I mean that) working on the amazing feedback we received during the event, so while this demo is the same our players loved trying out at our booth, we know it has a lot of room for improvement!

So here's what you can expect to see in the following weeks / months (just remember time flows differently for us unpaid undead):

[h2]Updated Character Selection[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/0ee325ca5722048bda74d6444b280aeaafcaed25.gif[/img]
At the moment, we know it can be quite confusing to change characters and starting a run, so improving that has been our top priority for the past couple of weeks!

Good news is this new screen is already fully implemented in-engine! This means you'll be seeing this screen by the next time we update the demo with more content (which shouldn't take long)!

[h2]Updated Boon Selection Screen[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/845460d6284d3e7f9b0c97e9a69025422b6ad583.png[/img]
Our team is currently finishing the implementation of this amazing visual update to our boon selection. Boons will have different border styles to help you quickly notice the difference between passive boons and active boons (weapons and spells).

We also heavily reworked boons to make sure their rarity is in fact obvious this time around. And if it isn't, let us know [strike]so we can make fun of you[/strike] and we'll figure something out.

[h2]Map Selection and a New Stage[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/9fd8ada80695be1cc817dfb89942cd2cd562d52c.png[/img]
Although these two are just mockups that Rogue stole from our R&D department so I could use in this post, we are also working on a stage selection system, which would be displayed as soon as you choose the character you wish to play as, sort of a follow up to our Character Selection screen.

Unfortunately we were only able to get our hands on screenshots for these, so more details and updates on these two will have to wait a bit longer.

[h2]Shooting Enemies[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/597d67c2a44d3c233726aa563134211b1cec690d.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/b6594bc1361697a3f9dcef5b185a002cae07270a.gif[/img]
We still haven't figured out who is training those villagers to use a bow, but I swear he will pay when we do.

Anyway, seems they didn't know how to shoot properly by the time this build was developed, so it should still take some time for you to meet them. Hopefully not too soon, 'cause I swear they're just there to make my job harder.

And that's a wrap!

Rogue told me there's still some stuff he noticed over at R&D's room, but he was almost caught and couldn't retrieve it for today's post. But I have a feeling he'll keep trying, so stay tuned!

Oh yeah, before I forget there is also another important thing: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/53efb6a7856a4411f33061b5ae049e0a37e775d7.gif[/img]
[h2]Our Discord server is now open for souls of the human realm![/h2] 
Do you want to keep in touch with us, share your ideas, brag about how much better you are in hunting down those poor villagers than everyone else, and other cool activities? Just click on the link below:

[url=https://discord.gg/xHRDNdgxGJ]Join our Discord![/url]

As always, thanks for reading and keep on living (until we come to collect)!

[b]E-Lich Corp[/b] - "We value your life. And death. Seriously."

notes.title: Demo Announcement & Gamescom Latam Recap
notes.content:
Greetings, esteemed collaborators!

Gamescom Latam is now past us, and we're very happy to say it [b]was to die for[/b]!

The positive reception for our demo blew our expectations away and got our team beyond excited to have you excited about the game! 

A huge thank you to everyone who played the game during the event, and a special thank you to those who waited in line to play it, because yeah, there were queues to play every single day! (we might even add a queue mechanic to the game since you like doing that so much)

(Oh, and an even more special thank you to those who wishlisted us on Steam!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/3b8219a6cea1ead84566685a1a758bdeac295d64.png[/img]

[h2]Demo[/h2]
We got a lot of important feedback (which is already being worked on as we speak, [b]we love extra work![/b]) as well as many questions, and of course, the main question was: "When is the Demo coming out?"

So... After a slight misunderstanding and one accidental Demon summoning, [b]we're glad to announce that our public Demo is currently already under review by the Steam Team![/b] This means you'll be able to play it in just a couple of days! (and if you don't, "blame the Intern" they said...)

And don't worry, there will be another announcement as soon as it is online, so you'll be notified as soon as you can play it. Please look forward to it!

[h2]Gamescom Latam Recap[/h2]
Now, for those of you who didn't get to meet us "live" (sorry, puns are the soul of our corporation), we're happy to give a sneak peek at how it was to participate in Gamescom Latam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/39367ae554463753e3b1f40b533e3476c4afefca.jpg[/img]
Our booth on Panorama Brasil was right near one of the entrances! So despite the freezing cold (which our team felt despite the lack of skin) coming in from the very large entrance doors on the last couple of days, it was a great spot to be on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/5e2361846f3a44aee84892e7d6f8787c5454ee46.jpg[/img]
We were also invited to participate in Banco do Brasil's official booth, having multiple people playing the game at once on awesome high-end setups!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/0dad6cdaf1b48bee02a07757efd8856dc7ee9d3f.jpg[/img]
We mentioned our booth had queues, but did we mention we were doing highscores? Some lucky collaborators managed to survive for quite impressive amounts of time, like Gabriel here, who beat the competition, the current boss and our balancing expectations (we appreciate the extra work)!

And that's about it! Pretty cool, huh?
Me and the boys were very happy to witness the event in its full glory from the office's computer screens (as undead weren't allowed to be on site. Discrimination, I tell you)!

Thank you once again for supporting our hard unpaid work!
Your enthusiastic souls are what fuels us! Literally.

Thanks for reading and keep on living (until we come to collect)!

[b]E-Lich Corp - "We value your life. And death. Seriously."[/b]

notes.title: Gamescom and other news for the living
notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/fb4a3873bbad1945fc12c834695ce39a4119eb77.png[/img]

notes.title: First update post of the year!
notes.content:
Greetings, esteemed collaborators! 2024 is finally here... Wait, what do you mean it’s been three months?! I’m pretty sure I read management’s previous notice just last week… Well, apologies for that. I suppose the notion of time is different when you're [strike]overworked[/strike] undead.

In any case, this is my first actual post here since Undead Resources [strike]dumped their workload[/strike] gave me this incredible opportunity to gain experience [strike]with no actual pay increase[/strike]!

This is finally the year where E-Lich: Corporate Souls will be available for all you lucky people from the mortal realm (which will hopefully increase our profits and let me actually have a salary). So with that said, I hope you're well and rested, because we're here today to show you our latest updates (which will mean more work for you and I very soon)!

[h2]The Talent Manager[/h2]
Someone in the office told me our first trailer lacked “life”. It took me a good while to understand, but I’m pretty sure they meant the fact that Miss Faye was kept out of it. Yeah, that’s probably it.

Anyway, meet [b]Faye[/b], The Talent Manager!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/b805e87493756cfad42200619cba4349ce224c21.gif[/img]
She’s the only living being in our company and is treated better than all of us, or so I heard. Mysteriously enough, upper management allows her to go on vacation multiple times a year. I wonder what one must do to get such a nice treatment…

Whenever she’s in office, however, she’ll be able to help you improve your talents! From brute force to life steal, she can grant you many useful power-ups. Rogue told me that “it’ll just cost the majority of your salary, but it’s absolutely worth it!” - What a steal!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Since the last update we’ve been working on several bug fixes in order to prepare for our [b]Demo release[/b], which if I heard the gossip correctly, should be somewhere around [REDACTED].

By the way, I noticed our developers track their bugs with unique IDs, which is kinda cool. However, seeing “BUG-105” made me unsure if the increasing digits are supposed to be a good thing or a bad thing... 

In any case, they said typing out every bug fix was a waste of time since the Demo wasn’t out yet, so I should just focus on sharing the more interesting news instead. Which reminds me…

[h2]Office Renovation[/h2]
I kept hearing how we were “low on budget” and how that impacted our salaries, so you can imagine my surprise when I walked in one day and they were renovating our entire lobby.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/07b5ba23312b78b3281864d856df3b6b6ae83114.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/cf87eba23d3dc3f8699861d5ed0714b39f46a72a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/3f02492165fbf000f7db3b0e2a64593e22712e7f.png[/img]
Dolores keeps denying it, but I’m certain that she knows how much was spent on this little project. Especially considering just how good it looks.

[h2]Sprite Visual Overhaul[/h2]
Speaking of looking good, our employees received a visual overhaul! If I didn't know any better, I'd even say they look more lively.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/6eb2b7616b25fbc7572930d3a4bdb2ae3479f70d.gif[/img]
And strangely enough, our enemies too. Their souls still look the same though…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800660/4c1b7499d15c7d0b6d8ec947661ffe23149b90d7.gif[/img]
If you’ve been following our social media as of late you might have caught a glimpse of some of these changes in action. If you haven’t, then be sure to follow us and so you don’t miss out on the latest news!

[b]Twitter[/b] - [url=https://twitter.com/elichgame]@elichgame[/url]
[b]Instagram[/b] - [url=https://www.instagram.com/elichgame/]@elichgame[/url]
[b]TikTok[/b] - [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@elichgame]@elichgame[/url]
[b]LinkedIn[/b] - [url=https://www.linkedin.com/company/elichgame/]elichgame[/url]

I’m not sure how our socials manage to get regular posts. I can’t even get a break to drink coffee anymore, much less keeping track of social media… 

Oh, and that reminds me! It seems plans to open a [b]Discord[/b] server have been finally set in motion, what with the Demo release talks and all. However, that’s all I’ve heard for the moment, so I’ll update you once they update the gossip about it. 

That’s it for our update! Please keep an eye on our future ones, hopefully I can do more of these if I’m not stuck with overtime. Thanks for reading and keep on living (until we come to collect)!

[b]E-Lich Corp[/b] - "We value your life. And death. Seriously."
